definitions.EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIABLE: A specified material proposition lacks trusted support; may coexist with a contradicted different claim.

definitions.ANNOTATION_UNCERTAIN: Interpretation/rubric application requires adjudication, including conditional readings.
definitions.STRUCTURALLY_UNSCORABLE: Evaluation unit unavailable under this view; not model factual falsity.
definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: Predeclared exclusion for that metric, not decided from outcome.
definitions.MISSING: Administrative absence of a required rating/confirmation, not epistemic uncertainty.
